description: React component for configuring Salesforce object write settings, including dynamic form fields, editing, and adding new fields.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for a specific row, populating editing data with current values.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing mode for a specific row, reverting changes.

methods.name: saveEditing
methods.description: Validates and saves the edited data, updating the writeToObjectData state.
